error[ZBX-E1001]: this zbx is not allowed to run virtual machines
  while  checking that this Mac can run a virtual machine
  cause  Virtualization.framework refused: The process doesn't have the
         "com.apple.security.virtualization" entitlement.
  fix    if you built zbx from source, sign it from the checkout:   codesign -f -s - --entitlements vm/zbx.entitlements $(which zbx)
         if you installed zbx, reinstall it, which is signed:       brew reinstall zigbox
  more   zbx explain E1001
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1001.html
